problem_solved: Need for fibre-enriched bakery products with improved nutritional value
description: This bread is prepared using fibre-rich material derived from osmotically dehydrated snake gourd and carrageenan processing residues. The product incorporates marine fibre to enhance nutritional value while maintaining the characteristics of a conventional bakery product. It offers an alternative approach for developing fibre-enriched foods.
